landing.headline: Resolve IT issues faster. Give your team room to breathe.
landing.subhead: An AI support agent that diagnoses, proposes, and resolves device issues — with human approval for every meaningful change.
landing.sectionTitle: From the first signal to a verified resolution
landing.feature1Body: Correlate device health, services, and ticket history to identify the real cause.
landing.feature2Body: System-changing actions always pass through policy and a clear approval step.
landing.feature3Body: The platform does not just run commands — it checks the result before closing a ticket.
landing.howTitle: AI handles the repetitive work. Technicians handle what matters.
landing.step1Body: Device telemetry creates a signal as soon as something looks wrong.
landing.step2Body: AI uses read-only tools to narrow down the root cause.
landing.step3Body: A technician approves the action; a separated agent executes it.
landing.step4Body: The result is checked and recorded in the audit trail.
landing.safetyTitle: Automation should never mean losing control.
landing.safetyBody: Tenant kill switches, risk tiers, per-action approvals, and a complete audit trail keep your team in charge of every AI decision.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take the pressure off IT?
landing.ctaBody: Start with repetitive tickets and expand automation at your own pace.
landing.footer: AI IT Support — intelligent operations, clear control.
ai.failed: AI processing failed. Your message is saved; select Retry.
ai.incomplete: Processing is incomplete. The device may not have responded or the diagnostic limit was reached. Review results and select Retry.
remote.title: Technical support
remote.error: Could not confirm the status. Try again; it will also refresh automatically.
remote.registered: MeshCentral link saved; check connection status in the console.
remote.unregistered: This device is not linked to MeshCentral.
remote.consent: Stop the AI session and wait for current actions to finish before taking control. Technicians must sign in to MeshCentral; the customer must approve the request on their device.
remote.install: In MeshCentral: create a separate device group for the customer, grant access only to assigned technicians, select Add Agent and install it on the client. On macOS, grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions. Then open the device in a separate tab and paste its link below. Mesh Agent is installed separately from Support Agent.
remote.node: MeshCentral device ID or link (leave blank to unlink)
remote.notReady: This device is not ready. Run the installer again to connect support automatically.
remote.enabledHint: A technician can request desktop control and Terminal commands for 60 minutes. Turn off to revoke support access.
remote.disabledHint: Turn on for desktop or Terminal support. You still need to approve access on your device.
linux.installHint: Linux x64/ARM64 with systemd. Requires bash, curl, Python 3 and sudo access. Technical support uses Terminal/CLI; no desktop required.
remote.terminalEnabledHint: Technicians can run commands as root for 60 minutes. Switch OFF to revoke access.
remote.terminalDisabledHint: Switch ON to allow technicians to run commands as root for 60 minutes. No desktop required.
